description: Event-specific retention classes for a bounded S-QSTN memory view. Exact human forgetting durations are not calibrated in v2.0.

retention_classes.memory_view_policy: Expose only inside the explicitly supplied memory horizon; otherwise mark the event expired.
retention_classes.ledger_policy: Keep the structured event for audit.
retention_classes.state_policy: Do not infer a persistent state update unless another explicit state rule applies.

retention_classes.memory_view_policy: Expose until an explicitly verified repair or replacement boundary is recorded.
retention_classes.ledger_policy: Keep the event and repair evidence for audit.
retention_classes.state_policy: Move to recovery or preserve residual caution; do not perform an instant full reset.

retention_classes.memory_view_policy: Expose a bounded caution summary after the event is verified.
retention_classes.ledger_policy: Keep the structured event for audit.
retention_classes.state_policy: Retain categorical caution until an explicit transition changes it.

retention_classes.memory_view_policy: Remove event details from the respondent memory view after the explicit policy window.
retention_classes.ledger_policy: Keep the structured event for audit.
retention_classes.state_policy: Do not infer that expiry means repair, forgiveness, or a full reset.

forgetting_boundary: A missing or expired memory-view item remains unknown. The respondent must not reconstruct it from question wording or model output.
